news.title: 2023 年，一位匿名模组制作者发布了十年来最好的恐怖游戏之一，但他们仍然没有打破角色
news.summary: MyHouse.wad barrages players with horrible things they've never experienced in a game before.

content.v: For a lot of people, the appeal of horror is being surprised and disturbed by something they've never seen before. In recent years, I've sourced this rare feeling from movies like Obsession, where the gender dynamics of that story made it feel a bit dangerous, or Speak No Evil, which has one of the most shocking and nihilistic endings that I can recall. I even find that freshness in a modern classic like Pearl, which isn't really scary, but contrasts a technicolour old Hollywood style with a singularly unsettling Mia Goth performance to great effect.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/N5WXFQSCttV6Am7CopwTzd-1920-80.png
This article is brought to you by No More Room in Hell 2 .

Fear of the unknown is more valuable to me as a viewer than seeing a really good version of something I've experienced before. In games, it's largely the same—I crave new places and themes above all else. It's why Silent Hill: Townfall, Mouthwashing, Dredge, Silent Hill f, and Still Wakes The Deep all succeeded for me. They're all set in locations or timeframes I've never seen anywhere else in games. I step into those worlds not knowing exactly what I'm going to find, and come out the other side feeling exhilarated in a profoundly nasty way. That's horror, baby.

From this decade, however, nothing in the horror genre has upended my expectations like MyHouse.wad. Everyone who plays this Doom 2 map seems to have the same experience: they know there's something weird about this mod set in a seemingly normal suburban home, but they spiral once they start playing it and realise how many secrets are impossibly embedded within its walls. They then become obsessed with trying to understand exactly how the house works. I consider it a modern horror classic because it's able to take players on this ride.

If you missed its release in 2023, the 'backstory' behind MyHouse.wad is that its creator had recently lost an important friend. Among his friend's belongings was a floppy disc containing an incomplete Doom map recreation of his parents' house. Since they both shared an interest in Doom mapping back in the '00s, the creator decided to honour his friend's memory by finishing his work. Except, of course, this story is all fiction, and the Doom map in question turns out to be a hellish labyrinth disguised as a lovely home. Its real creator? Still officially unknown.
MyHouse.wad is relentlessly tense, and punctuated by a series of 'WTF' moments that keep you wondering what evil thing you've downloaded.

On the first run through MyHouse.wad, it does indeed look like a normal suburban house, albeit one filled with Doom monsters. After killing the patrolling enemies, you exit the house, look in from the outside, and realise it's somehow filled with monsters again. You go inside to gun them down and learn the house has subtly changed: new doors appear, leading to rooms that weren't there before and architecturally impossible spaces. Key visual details have been altered. Crucially, too, the sound design begins messing with your head, resetting and then distorting Doom 2's classic Running From Evil music, or playing the Discord notification sound as a jump scare. No matter where you go, too, the general shape of the environment somehow still looks exactly like the house…
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/VpYkf5XgMFtgBcv3ju5cT-1920-80.png

The unsettling details of the spaces you're exploring just pile up—MyHouse.wad is relentlessly tense, and punctuated by a series of 'WTF' moments that keep you wondering what evil thing you've downloaded. There's no question that the choice of a simple family home as the backdrop contributes to how disturbing it is.
Bless this mess
MyHouse.wad is just as mischievous as it is scary.

The first thing that very online people will tell you about this mod is that it's inspired by House of Leaves, an experimental novel by Mark Z. Danielewski (which has also been cited as an influence on Remedy's Alan Wake and Control). The mod shares the premise of a house that's larger on the inside than it seems from the outside, with the interior undergoing constant bizarre changes. There are several direct references to specific details from the book.

But while reading House of Leaves these days feels like work—I got the distinct impression I'd have appreciated its experimental structure and overwrought style much more if I'd read it at 21, rather than my late 30s—MyHouse.wad is just as mischievous as it is scary.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/3ceUKRMx29vUBHrJ7wKra-1920-80.png

I feel its anonymous creator chuckling darkly at me as I see the house refill with monsters, or when I shoot a horrible giant fish guarding a swimming pool and see it explode into tinier evil fish that are much harder to kill. The creator is definitely laughing at me as I fight an evil version of Shrek outside a nursery. While the story of the mod gestures at darker themes, it's almost like the creator is playing a series of pranks on you, subverting your expectations of Doom as they go (illustrated by John Romero himself streaming it multiple times and frequently stopping to admire its tricks).

My relationship with MyHouse.wad is similar to how I felt about Kojima Productions' PT . It's not something I necessarily play for its mechanics—even though it's still Doom, of course. You're more focused on unpicking the 'how did they do that?' factor of its impossible architecture, the nightmarish logic of how the different areas link together or why its more novel monsters are even there. It's one giant mystery with a load of little mysteries buried inside it.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/nUQVobyWzyVY3jZoT8GTK-1920-80.png

Another thing it has in common with PT is how scant details are on its creation, which feeds into the overall legend surrounding it. As mentioned, we still don't officially know who made MyHouse.wad—the creepypasta-style files in the mod's Google Drive folder don't give anything away. Its credited creator is Steven Nelson, AKA Veddge, but that's just a pseudonym. Veddge's Doomworld account was active until 2006, at which point they took a hiatus until they started posting again in 2022. That too feeds into the wad's myth. Veddge has not posted once since the mod was released in 2023, either.
It's packed with the kind of moments or clever twists that would become iconic if they featured in full games.

I'm almost too vain to accept the idea that someone could create something this good then disappear into the wilderness without taking credit for it. But this confidential origin story is a key part of MyHouse.wad's creative identity. Anyone with a search engine and a spare hour can piece together who the creator almost certainly is (and in-game credits shed light on who else contributed to the project), but I wouldn't give that much thought. The intention behind the mod's creation is to blur fiction and reality in this way that enhances the experience. Let the mystery be.
House secrets

Replaying it now, what is staggering about MyHouse.wad is that it's packed with the kind of moments or clever twists that would become iconic if they featured in full games. People still talk about Psycho Mantis reading your PlayStation memory card in Metal Gear Solid almost three decades later. But this mod has maybe four or five moments that evoked a similar 'no way…' response from me as a player, all happening inside this single map.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/R4GVTEjTr9YpxSzJsFY5d-1920-80.png

news.title: 据报道，英伟达首席执行官曾被中国间谍盯上，此前涉嫌走私人工智能芯片
news.summary: Nvidia says Huang would've only spoken about "ordinary business information" with a data center exec anyways.

content.v: Jensen Huang, Nvidia's CEO and one of AI's most important people, was reportedly targeted by a data centre executive working as a spy for the Chinese government, a new report suggests.

According to the New York Times , citing undisclosed sources that were briefed on the matter, Alice Huang, also known as Huang Le, was being watched by US agencies due to suspicion of involvement in data centre chip smuggling from Singapore. During that surveillance, the officials are said to have determined that Alice Huang was acting as an intelligence asset.

Moreover, those officials are also said to have determined that Alice Huang had a close relationship with Jensen Huang (no relation). The NYT suggests that officials were concerned that Alice Huang may have been able to extract information from this relationship that would be useful to the Chinese state—what with Nvidia being pivotal to America's AI efforts.

It's said that Jensen Huang had, at the time, not been briefed on the threat of foreign intelligence services. It was later implied Nvidia was not briefed on Alice Huang, either. The Nvidia CEO has a close relationship with US president Donald Trump, and has travelled with the US president to China and was more recently called by the president while on stage at an AI event .

The US has approved the sale of some AI chips to China, though they are not the cutting-edge Blackwell chips that US firms have access to—providing they pay a pretty penny, anyways. China had been blocking some of these chips on its side, but recent reports suggest older Nvidia H200 cards are reaching China in small amounts .

As it stands, the White House, CIA, and NSA have all declined to comment to the NYT. Who knew what, and when, is still up in the air. Even Alice Huang's status with the data centre company that was under scrutiny for chip smuggling, Megaspeed, is not currently clear.

Nvidia has also pushed back on a few of the claims made in the NYT report. The company says that claims Megaspeed had any involvement in chip smuggling were debunked last year in a statement to CNBC .
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/hYpyAaA3sEs774SXS6x5mW-1920-80.jpg
"The diversion allegations against this regional cloud were thoroughly investigated and debunked last year,” says spokesperson John Rizzo.
Rizzo also pushed back on Huang's relationship with Alice Huang being anything exceptional to the NYT.
“Jensen’s interactions with Ms. Huang are not unusual or unexpected. Meetings with customers are part of a CEO’s job; Jensen talks with thousands of customer executives every year.”

He also added that Nvidia believes the US government would have made it known had there been any threat to American industry, and that Megaspeed would have received "ordinary business information" and not trade secrets; "zero information relevant to national security."

news.title: 极限竞速赛车运动总监兼 Turn 10 老板 Dan Greenawalt 在任职 27 年后从微软退休
news.summary: Dan Greenawalt, a 27-year Microsoft employee who helped build Turn 10 Studios from scratch and directed eight

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/29/forzamotorsport-2023-blog-1696401871647-1793294503886.jpg

Dan Greenawalt, a 27-year Microsoft employee who helped build Turn 10 Studios from scratch and directed eight Forza Motorsport games spanning all four Xbox console generations, is retiring from Microsoft, according to a new report.

The Verge's Tom Warren reports that he's seen an internal memo that confirms Greenawalt's departure. “Dan Greenawalt has decided that this is the right time for him to retire from Microsoft,” said Playground Games studio head Trevor Williams. Playground, who develops the Forza Horizon franchise, was merged with Greenawalt's Turn 10 last month as part of Xbox's ongoing " reset ."

Williams added, in part, "It’s hard to overstate Dan’s impact over the past 27 years. From shipping Project Gotham Racing on the original Xbox in 2001 to leading the creation of Forza, founding Turn 10 Studios and appearing so many times on our E3 stage, usually making a dramatic entrance with a supercar in tow."

Unfortunately, it looks as though 2023's Forza Motorsport, which was meant to be a platform of sorts that would be evolved and added onto, might be the last Motorsport game for the foreseeable future, if ever, after layoffs hit Turn 10 last year and reportedly relegated the remaining team to support duty on the highly profitable Forza Horizon. Motorsport will not be getting any more new content .
Greenawalt's Forza Motorsport series consistently earned critical acclaim, with all eight games scoring an 8 out of 10 or higher at IGN.

news.title: 你们都猜到了《上古卷轴 6》的名字，现在这是游戏的设置 – 报告
news.summary: After eight years , Xbox is reportedly preparing to reintroduce The Elder Scrolls VI to the world. And this ti

content.v: After eight years , Xbox is reportedly preparing to reintroduce The Elder Scrolls VI to the world. And this time, the game will apparently get an official subtitle: Sentinel. According to The Verge , Bethesda could reveal the full name next month in celebration of Skyrim's 15th anniversary. That's not all, though.

The report states that Hammerfell will serve as the setting for Sentinel. It's a massive region that's southwest of Skyrim and probably best known for being playable in The Elder Scrolls Online . As for the narrative, the RPG "will be the first game about the history of the Elder Scrolls," per The Verge. That means discovering "the secrets of these mysterious ancient artifacts" in Sentinel.

It's unknown how much Bethesda will showcase, if the re-reveal does in fact happen in November. However, the report states that gameplay demonstrations are taking place, following up Xbox CEO Asha Sharma saying she saw the game in August. At that time, Sharma teased The Elder Scrolls VI's subtitle, and fans correctly figured out it's Sentinel --at least reportedly right now. She also noted that the game's "scale and grandeur are incredible."

Earlier this year, Skyrim director Todd Howard expressed that he knows his team at Bethesda needs "to get it right" with The Elder Scrolls VI . The majority of people at Bethesda Game Studios are working on the RPG currently.
As for whether The Elder Scrolls 6 could be an Xbox console exclusive , Sharma is playing coy about that possibility. What we do know is that Bethesda has a new logo .

news.title: 谷歌股价暴跌 5000 亿美元，称“我们对自己的发展轨迹感到非常满意”
news.summary: More than a little nibble.

content.v: Even during a good financial year, a big tech investor is seemingly never satisfied. Case in point, while Google Search grew by 12% year-over-year and made $63.3 billion this past quarter, parent company Alphabet's share price took a pretty spectacular tumble.

Despite making an amount of money the mere thought of which sucks the air right out of my lungs, Search's revenue this quarter was actually below Wall Street's expectations. As a result, Alphabet's shares are down 13% and $500 billion has been wiped from its market value (via The Financial Times ).

The share price is continuing to fluctuate and, according to CNBC , it could be the worst post-earnings call decline ever. This follows $1 trillion worth of air escaping from the AI party balloon earlier this month , due to anxious investors widely selling off stock. So, how did Alphabet get its ABC's so wrong? Long story short, Google's own AI features may be eating into its Search revenue.

This is despite Search apparently seeing the fastest year-over-year query growth rate in half a decade. During Alphabet's most recent earnings call , Google's senior vice president and chief business officer Philipp Schindler was asked to explain this 'disconnect'.

"It's worth noting that the strong growth in AI Mode queries had an impact because of the lower monetization we were seeing in AI Mode," Schindler says. "To be clear, we feel very good about our trajectory here. Our ad experiments have shown promising results, and we're now scaling ads within both AI Overviews and AI Mode to more users and more queries, including, as I mentioned, international markets and multiturn ads in the US."
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/jXqdZNznwAgMFVjiRtMsaj-1920-80.png

In other words, yes, AI Mode is eating Search's lunch but Google is hoping to scale up its kitchen production in order to keep both of its babies fed. Or something like that—the metaphor got away from me in the middle there.

Anyway, these financial results only serve to add fuel to the fire of investor fear that Google Search is getting singed by the likes of ChatGPT. I mean, compare and contrast the amount of ads you see on the first page of Google results against what you typically see from an LLM chatbot. As Google tells it, more ads are likely coming to AI Overviews and AI Mode in the near future to remedy its 'disconnect.'

On top of what investors are seeing as financial underperformance, Google is also knee deep in negative cash flow. Initial projections suggested this wouldn't venture into the red beyond $3.5 billion, but Google was actually looking at minus $9.1 billion at the end of September. This is apparently only the second quarter in which Google has reported negative cash flow since it went public back in 2004.

Having spent $51.3 billion on AI in the last quarter alone, such a plunge is perhaps unsurprising. The company intends to spend even more in the future, having apparently committed itself to data centre and related purchases in excess of $1 trillion—despite investors growing increasingly anxious about whether a return on AI investment will ever fully materialise.

others.title: 育碧没有新的《刺客信条》重制版

content.v: 《刺客信条》官方今日发布了秋季更新公告，向玩家分享了系列近期的工作进展与未来规划。在本次公告中，官方重点介绍了目前正在开发中的两款全新系列作品，并对未来的重制版计划作出了明确回应。
视频：
针对开发中的新游戏，官方重点提及了代号为“Hexe”和“Invictus”的两个项目。
《刺客信条》代号Hexe被官方定义为一款风格更加黑暗的作品。目前该作正稳步开发中，但前方仍有大量工作要完成。开发团队表示将专注于实现这款作品的独特核心愿景，并确认将于2027年分享关于本作的下一波重大更新，同时感谢玩家一直以来的耐心与不减的热情。

另一款正在开发的代号Invictus是一项野心勃勃的多人游戏项目。此前，已有数百名玩家参与了其内部测试。玩家对PvP多人游戏模式的回归反应相当正面，尤其喜欢地图的跑酷设计、垂直空间、团队合作玩法，以及能够扮演系列中不同角色的设定。不过，玩家也反馈希望看到更多《刺客信条》系列的核心要素。对此，开发团队在过去几个月里积极回应，目前Invictus正朝着令人振奋的新方向发展，在保留多人游戏目标的同时，更充分体现系列特色。官方也提醒，由于游戏仍在开发中，网传的部分信息可能并不完整或已过时。
除了新作，官方也更新了已发售游戏的动态：《刺客信条：黑旗 记忆重置》已推出最后一次大型更新；而玩家突破4000万的《刺客信条：英灵殿》也将于11月5日推出玩家期待已久的“新游戏+”模式。
最后，官方明确表示，目前没有其他《刺客信条》重制版正在开发中。开发团队的重心已放在系列接下来的新篇章上（包括尚未公开的全新时代背景与故事），但官方也强调，未来仍会持续探索让旧作回归玩家视野的机会。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/30/small_202610300104086511.png
此外，Netflix《刺客信条》真人版影集在罗马的拍摄已进入尾声，官方还预告了2027年将迎来系列20周年，届时将有一整年的精彩活动等待玩家。

news.summary: A new report claims that the next Elder Scrolls game will be titled The Elder Scrolls 6: Sentinel, along with

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/08/11/tes6-1786479096622.jpg
A new report claims the next Elder Scrolls game will be titled The Elder Scrolls 6: Sentinel , along with new story details.

According to The Verge , The Elder Scrolls 6: Sentinel is the title of the highly-anticipated follow-up to Bethesda's Skyrim. This title has been rumored for some time now , but The Verge is putting extra weight behind it. According to the outlet, the game's title could be formally announced as soon as next month, possibly aligned with either Skyrim's 15th anniversary or Xbox's 25th anniversary. The game will reportedly take place in Hammerfell and dive into the history of the titular artifacts, allowing players to discover their secrets firsthand for the first time.

All of this is pretty exciting and shows that the game is likely getting closer to release. While we're not quite sure when to expect The Elder Scrolls 6, it wouldn't be surprising if we hear more details next year ahead of a 2028 release. However, Bethesda does like to wait until its games are close to the finish line to really lay it all out there, so we may be waiting a while before we get raw gameplay.

The road to The Elder Scrolls 6 has been quite long, as Bethesda announced the game back in 2018. At that stage, the game was still in the very, very early stages of pre-production. It may not have even really been anything more than a concept at that point, since Bethesda was full steam ahead on Starfield, which wouldn't release for another five years from that point. Since shipping Starfield, The Elder Scrolls 6 has become a massive priority and the studio's focus going forward.

Although there is a lot happening in and around Bethesda with future Fallout games, re-releases, and Starfield updates, The Elder Scrolls 6 seems to be taking the bulk of the developer's focus. The only question now is: will it all be worth the long wait?

news.title: 丹尼斯·戴克 (Denis Dyack) 表示，“AAA 出版商正在滥用抢先体验”，这让其他人的处境变得更加困难
news.summary: Dyack believes that games like Subnautica 2 are "skewing player expectations" for early access games.

content.v: Denis Dyack, known for his work on games including Blood Omen: Legacy of Kain and Eternal Darkness: Sanity's Requiem, says big game developers are "abusing early access" by using it as a marketing tool for highly polished games that are ready for full release anyway. That, Dyack believes, has shifted expectations for early access releases overall, and made life more difficult for indie developers who rely on the process to actually get their games finished and launched.

"They can put up a polished product and rake in cash," Dyack told GamesIndustry . "It's a marketing beat for them. So, that leaves players often expecting a near-perfect game that, in our opinion, defeats the purpose of early access, which is a collaborative development process based on player feedback.
"AAA publishers are abusing early access, skewing player expectations in such a way that it heavily disadvantages smaller independent developers."

Dyack said games like Subnautica 2 and Path of Exile are "drastically changing the landscape and players' expectations," which in turn has led to "significant barriers to entry" for less polished games like Dyack's current project, Deadhaus Sonata , which is now in early access on Steam.

Ethan McKinnon, who joined Deadhaus Sonata developer Apocalypse Studios as creative director after the game's rough early access launch earlier this year, added that "players naturally compare everything in the same marketplace, so smaller teams are being held to a much higher standard than they were in the past."

Interestingly, Subnautica 2 creative director Anthony Gallegos seemed to agree with at least part of Dyack's proposition, saying in the same report that early access is "not a few edge-case games participating anymore."

"Early access could mean a game like ours doing long-term open development, or it could be a game three months from a 1.0 release that's effectively doing a paid beta soft launch and using the Early Access term as a way to soften player expectations," Gallegos said. The result, he continued, is a "more diverse and confusing landscape."

I think that point is more salient here than any perceived 'abuse' by big publishers: It's tough to set meaningful broad expectations for "early access" when it's such a loosely defined term in the first place. But even though I'm not entirely convinced by Dyack's argument, he and McKinnon do have sensible advice for developers looking at early access launches: Ensure the game runs well, pay attention to Steam reviews, and connect with influencers who can get it in front of eyeballs.

Dyack admitted that Apocalypse Studios missed those points with the early access release of Deadhaus Sonata earlier this year. "We failed to prioritize the basics right from the get-go," Dyack said. "Also, we didn't handle Unreal Engine properly at the time and didn't do a good job explaining what made our game cool and different. In a lot of ways, we were too focused on what made our game so different and unique that it took our attention away from making sure we got the basics done right."
McKinnon put it more simply: "Developers need to treat early access like a real launch, because players do."

news.title: 原版《GTA》艺术家表示，看到自己的影响力在《GTA 6》封面艺术中延续下去，他感到“受宠若惊”
news.summary: Stephen Bliss, the former Rockstar Games artist who helped establish Grand Theft Auto's iconic visual style, h

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/13/gta-3-cover-blog-1791888082659.jpg

Stephen Bliss, the former Rockstar Games artist who helped establish Grand Theft Auto's iconic visual style, has said he's flattered to see elements of his original designs continue to appear in the cover art for GTA 6.

Speaking to IGN at Lucca Comics and Games, Bliss, who worked at Rockstar from 2001 to 2016, reflected on his contribution to the series and how his work continues to influence its visual identity, even a decade after his departure.

"Well, I looked at the GTA 6 cover, for example. I had nothing to do with that, but the fact they still use the box grid and they still put the helicopter in the top left corner, which was something that I developed, I'm flattered by that," Bliss said. "It touches me that that heritage continues. And my influence is in the GTA 6 cover, but it's its own language. I just have little references in there. I'm like, 'Oh, that's nice that they used that.' But I'm absolutely not saying I contributed to that massively."

Bliss was instrumental in establishing the comic book-inspired look of Grand Theft Auto's promotional artwork, including the grid layout that has become synonymous with the franchise. However, he was also keen to emphasize the contributions of other Rockstar artists, including Anthony Macbain and Steven Olds.

Bliss explained that while he's spent the past decade establishing his own artistic identity outside Rockstar, he remains grateful for his time working on the series and the impact it continues to have.

The full interview with Bliss also explores how the September 11 attacks influenced the GTA 3 cover art, and the creative challenges behind the distinctive visual styles of Vice City and San Andreas. Check it out here .

news.title: 侠盗猎车手史蒂芬·布利斯 (Stephen Bliss) 解释了他如何定义该系列的标志性视觉风格
news.summary: As a senior artist at Rockstar Games from 2001 to 2016, Stephen Bliss defined the iconic pop art and comic boo

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/29/gtacovers-blogroll-1793289918640.jpeg

You might not immediately recognize the name Stephen Bliss, but I guarantee you'll recognize his work on arguably the most influential game franchise of our time. As a senior artist at Rockstar Games from 2001 to 2016, he defined the iconic pop art and comic book feel that has become the visual hallmark for Grand Theft Auto. IGN spoke to him at the Lucca Comics and Games festival about his work with the series, what he's been working on since, and finding the balance between making a name for himself away from the brand and seeing his artistic impact continue even as he works on other projects.

IGN: I was reading an interview with you where you said you didn't want to be known as the GTA guy, but you take it as an affirmation that people know your work and are inspired by that. Is that something that has been tricky to navigate in the past 10 years?

Stephen Bliss: I wanted to make a name for myself away from Rockstar in fine art and to make my own IPs, my own properties, and cartoons. And that's worked to a degree, and it's getting stronger all the time, my career. But I can't ignore what working at Rockstar has done for me. I'm very grateful for getting a job there and working there for such a long time. After GTA 3, Vice City, and Warriors, the team came in, Anthony Macbain [Director of Illustration at Rockstar for 13 years] and Steven Olds [former visualization director at Rockstar Games], who are both amazing artists. So when people tell me that they love my work, I might not completely be overwhelmed with the flattery of that, because other people did the work, and I don't want other people to think that I did all the work. When I said that quote before, what I meant was I don't want to take all the credit.

People have been bringing me GTA 5 covers to sign, and I say sorry, because I didn't work on that. And they look disappointed, but I've got to let people know what I did and what I didn't do. But I did contribute massively to Rockstar. And as I said, I'm grateful for that. And sometimes it can be like people are walking past my stand and they'll see all my personal work, Fear City work, and gig posters I did for bands and comics I've done, but they're really interested in more in the GTA getting that signed, or they're interested in a poster that's inspired by GTA for Lucca. But that's okay, because I did something well.
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/29/9245b6dd45a143b26a7877ec5a29bb5c3fc00eda-1790721291674.webp
IGN: What you did, it set a standard; it set a style. I know there were other contributors to that, but as an artist, is that something that you see as an affirmation?

Stephen Bliss: Well, I looked at the GTA 6 cover, for example. I had nothing to do with that, but the fact they still use the box grid and they still put the helicopter in the top left corner, which was something that I developed, I'm flattered by that. It touches me that that heritage continues. And my influence is in the GTA 6 cover, but it's its own language. I just have little references in there. I'm like, 'Oh, that's nice that they used that.' But I'm absolutely not saying I contributed to that massively.

IGN: Is it difficult to convey something that is telling part of a story that sucks people in but isn't telling a whole story? Is that a challenge? Is that a puzzle that you have to solve as an artist?

Stephen Bliss: Yeah. What I'm missing with my work since I left Rockstar, for example, is that there's an emotional connection with people growing up and seeing that GTA work, which has actually been a good lesson for me recently. I realized that whatever I do from now on has to create an emotional connection. And even if I draw the anatomy badly or I'm being anal about getting everything correct, if it doesn't connect with someone emotionally, then that's where there's a disconnection. So I'm trying now to create some kind of emotional connection, which I'm not quite sure how I do that right now.
IGN: Is there a trick to that, or is it just kind of feeling your way through it?

Stephen Bliss: I know I've been trying to do it for 10 years since I left, and even Steroid [a t-shirt company Bliss set up with his brother], my project before I came to New York. I'm trying to revive that. And I've got the Fear City IP [a NFT series on the Ethereum blockchain], and I've got the Looby IP [an art-focused cryptocurrency], and my ambition now is to pull them all together as the Stephen Bliss brand. What I need is someone to finance that and market it. Those are the two major things that are missing. There have been people [who have come in with money], but they're full of shit really. But I'm hoping at some point someone will come in as a decent person and invest in it.

IGN: In an interview that Dan Hauser did with IGN , he mentioned you and the post-9/11 cover update. Is there anything that you remember about that process? Were they all-nighters where you just had to sit there and really lock in and change everything?

Stephen Bliss: Well, it was a lot to ask, to do a nonviolent GTA cover. But I understood because I personally was thinking, “Is entertainment from now on going to be all musicals and comedies and Disney? How are we going to be able to sell something that has a degree of violence in it?” And nobody knew. I was convinced it's all musicals [from- now on]. So when they asked for that, even though the [white] GTA 3 cover took me six months to paint, I'd always had in my head the grid system. “How can I chop these out? Chop out the nonviolent images, and what are you going to do with them?” I put them in a grid system because I grew up with Marvel and DC. I found a picture the other day - that really reminded me of that GTA cover - that I did when I was 10.

So for me it was almost... I mean, it was literally two nights. It wasn't an all-nighter, I don't think. Sometimes I'm pleased with myself; it's like I can get ideas really quickly. I may not be too bright on finance and investments, but I can come up with abstract ideas pretty quickly. And that was one of the big ones.
IGN: Were there any particular series or comics from Marvel or DC that really had a long-lasting impact or major impact with you, either on the GTA covers or your other work?

Stephen Bliss: Looking at the comic collection that I still have from when I was a kid, it was Spider-Man and the Titans. The Hulk and Spider-Man were the [ones] that I still have from when I was a kid. I still love Spider-Man and the Hulk. I still get excited about seeing them in the movies.

IGN: We were talking about Vice City and GTA San Andreas. There’s very obviously a Stephen Bliss style. I know you said other people contributed, but Vice City is obviously very colorful, and then you moved on to something a little bit grittier. Does that require a change in process? Or was it just like, “This is the brief, this is the game, this is how I'm going to take my style and bring it to life in a different environment?"

Stephen Bliss: Well, so after Vice City there was... I did Warriors on my own, and that was a real challenge, because I had to do a style that was completely different from GTA 3 but similar. And I started off doing it as GTA 3 because that's my style, that's my natural style. And then I just had to go completely out of the box and do that really kind of photographic painting. Somehow I had to find a way to do it. And that was always the case; find a way to do it. I still do that now with my freelance work. I say to my agent sometimes, I don't want to do it because I can't do it. And I do it because he always persuades me to do it. And I always feel pretty good about that, that I'm like, "Wow, I did something I didn't think I could do."

news.title: Xbox 希望到 2030 年比 PlayStation 和任天堂更有利可图
news.summary: Xbox CEO Asha Sharma has an ambitious goal: not only to make Xbox more lucrative, but to surpass the profit ma

content.v: Xbox CEO Asha Sharma has an ambitious goal: not only to make Xbox more lucrative, but to surpass the profit margins of its biggest gaming rivals, Sony and Nintendo.

Speaking to CNBC , Sharma said Microsoft was working to achieve this goal by mid-2030 and had a variety of plans in place, from focusing on more exclusive titles to gaining more ground in the casual games market. "We will build long-term plans for our biggest franchises across film, television, consumer products, sponsorship, live experiences, and form new partnerships globally, including China," Sharma wrote in an Xbox memo, adding that the company will invest heavily in Minecraft and that revenue growth is expected to speed up in the 2028 and 2029 fiscal years.
"By Financial Year 2030, our ambition is to be halfway to our long-term daily-player goal with sustained double-digit growth in players and engagement and industry-leading margins," she wrote.

While Sharma aims to increase Xbox's player and revenue growth in the fiscal year ending June 2027, things don't look too good for the division right now. According to Circana tracking data , US Xbox Series hardware sales fell 27% year-over-year in September 2026--reaching a new all-time September low--and Sharma recently posted online that revenue had declined in the most recent financial quarter. Sharma added that "console sales remain constrained by supply," but she was vague on the specifics. At the same time, Xbox console prices rose again in August, making it more expensive than ever to buy one compared with its original launch price in November 2020.

Xbox has also gone through a brutal "reset" phase ever since Sharma took over, with over 1,600 jobs eliminated and several studios cut from the Xbox portfolio. If Microsoft wants to make Xbox more profitable than Sony and Nintendo, it could face an uphill battle, as Xbox recorded a 10% quarterly revenue decline. By comparison, CNBC reported that Sony reached a 9.9% operating margin from game and network services alone in its latest financial year, while Nintendo was close to 16% in its fiscal year.

Xbox's current strategy seems focused on more than just gaming, as the new XP division was unveiled earlier this month. Dedicated to movies, TV, and live events, it follows several recent multimedia project announcements, including the third season of the Fallout TV series , a Call of Duty movie , a Diablo animated series , and a Minecraft theme park opening in 2027.

news.title: 专家称 Xbox 最近的努力没有改变任何事情，未来仍然黯淡
news.summary: Xbox CEO Asha Sharma has undertaken a number of efforts thus far to help get the business back into a healthy

content.v: Xbox CEO Asha Sharma has undertaken a number of efforts thus far to help get the business back into a healthy place, and nothing has worked, Circana analyst Mat Piscatella says.
He told The Game Business that based on the sales and engagement data he sees for the US gaming industry, "I'm not seeing [the moves] have any positive impact" for Xbox.

The disc-to-digital program "hasn't changed their sales of new physical software trend at all," he added. Additionally, making Gears of War: E-Day exclusive on console to Xbox "hasn't made any difference" in terms of selling more Xbox hardware. In fact, Xbox sales continue to spiral . Sharma says there is a supply issue, but, in the US at least, you can get a new Xbox very easily .

Piscatella said E-Day is a "Gears-ass Gears of War game," and a gorgeous one. But making it exclusive to Xbox created a scenario where "you chop the legs out" from under its potential potential to boost Xbox generally. "At least in the short term, it hasn't made a difference," he said.

There was clear and obvious evidence that E-Day was planned for PS5 , but it was never released on Sony's console. Other industry experts said Microsoft purposefully sent E-Day out to die "for hearts and minds."

Additionally, Piscatella said Sharma's decision to remove new Call of Duty games from Game Pass was another loser of a decision. He said the data he's seeing shows that the Call of Duty franchise "lost a ton of engagement" due to Modern Warfare 4 being stripped out of Game Pass.
"And you got no benefit. It’s really hard to find any signs of positivity or hope on that platform right now," he said.

Piscatella went on to say that the efforts Microsoft is undertaking are for "Twitter likes" from hardcore fans. "But other than that, in terms of actual results, I'm not seeing anything right now," he said.

Sharma's turnaround plan for Xbox was never expected to yield immediate results--she only took the job in February and she inherited numerous foundational problems. In a memo to staff seen by CNBC , Sharma said she's taking a "long-term" view to help turn things around, and that includes pushing every studio to return to growth for players and revenue by the end of the fiscal year ending June 2027. Beyond games, Sharma has established a unit called XP , which will expand Xbox's games across film, TV, consumer products, sponsorships, and live experiences, as well as new initiatives in China.

Also in the memo, Sharma said she will push her teams to help Xbox get back in line with rivals Sony and Nintendo by 2027 in terms of profit margins, and then beat them by mid-2030. For comparison, Xbox currently reports about a 3% internal margin, which compares to 9.9% for PlayStation and 16% for Nintendo, according to CNBC.
A 3% profit margin means that for every $100 that Xbox brings in, it spent $97 to do so and keeps $3. A higher profit margin is better, and that's what Sharma is pushing for.

news.title: 《猛鬼追魂》系列将于 2027 年万圣节推出三款新桌面改编版本
news.titleEn: The Hellraiser Franchise Is Getting Three New Tabletop Adaptations for Halloween 2027

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/29/hellraiser-1987-1588021616233-160w-1793289260175.webp
Pinhead 和《猛鬼追魂》的其他成员现在看到了这种复苏，而且这种情况预计会持续到明年。 Salt Entertainment 今天宣布，他们已与 Clive Barker 和 Park Ave Ent 达成协议。 LLC 将发布不是一款、不是两款而是三款官方《地狱追魂》桌面游戏，其中第一款计划于 2027 年万圣节发布。恰逢原版电影 40 周年纪念日。

Salt目前推出的地狱般的游戏首先是由设计师Travis Chance（《克苏鲁：黑暗普罗维登斯》、《英雄通缉》）设计的《猛鬼追魂：血肉之谜》，这是一款基于骰子/碰运气的游戏，主题围绕该系列标志性的哀叹配置框。索尔特将其描述为“密室逃脱风格和社交推理游戏，其中隐藏的欲望、不断变化的忠诚度和可疑的选择让人们越来越难以知道该信任谁或什么”。这些邪恶的小盒子是电影中最知名的一些遗物，我很高兴看到它们所代表的东西如何在明年万圣节上映时适应每周游戏之夜。

如果您更喜欢故事驱动的游戏，那么您也很幸运，因为一款成熟的 Hellraiser 桌面角色扮演游戏也在开发中。该项目由设计师 Franceso Nepitello 负责，他在将大型游戏改编成 TTRPG 方面拥有一些经验，也是基于指环王的 One Ring RPG 的联合设计师。其他人可能因为另一款以那个宇宙为背景的小游戏而认识他，《指环战》——我们认为这款游戏是 LoTR 时期最好的棋盘游戏之一。这款角色扮演游戏旨在让粉丝扩展和开放《猛鬼追魂》的宇宙，让您探索并演绎属于我们自己世界之外的诱惑、欲望和恐怖的故事。
“多年来我一直想设计一款恐怖角色扮演游戏，”内皮泰洛说。 “与《Hellraiser》一起玩是非常令人兴奋的。它融合了恐惧、欲望和禁忌知识，在游戏桌上提供了很多值得探索的东西。我迫不及待地想与玩家一起打开盒子。”

这一系列游戏中的最后一款是我最想了解更多的游戏。由游戏设计师 Michael Shinall 领导，他是《Marvel Zombies》、《冰与火之歌：桌面微缩模型游戏》、《血源：桌游》以及最近由 Salt Entertainment 制作的《Tasting History》桌游（目前在 Kickstarter 上）等其他游戏的开发者。在这三款游戏中，这是我们了解最少的一款，仅被描述为“一款重要的全新《猛鬼追魂》棋盘游戏”。谈到与如此传奇的作品合作，Shinall 对这个 IP 的含义有着深刻的理解，“《猛鬼追魂》在恐怖世界中是独一无二的，除了出色的怪物和世界设计之外，它以许多其他人试图效仿但往往无法达到的方式深入探讨了人类心理的范围。它承认，最真实的恐怖从来不是外在的，而是内心的。”灵魂最黑暗部分的深处……我期待着将其带入新的媒介。”

在与 Salt Entertainment 总裁杰夫·斯金纳 (Geoff Skinner) 谈论巴克对这些项目的投入时，他是这样说的； “是的，克莱夫·巴克（Clive Barker）批准了一切并指导我们的创意，所以我们都在全力以赴。我们不仅使用电影作为基础，还使用原创中篇小说《地狱之心》。与任何品牌的原创者合作总是一种享受，但与如此深刻地塑造了文化的人合作绝对是一种荣幸。他对《地狱追魂》电子游戏的热度很高（作者注：查看我们在这里所做的评论）和两个Kickstarter 众筹活动（漫画和书籍）取得了巨大成功，我们很高兴成为 Barkerverse 的一部分。”
涉及 Puzzle of Flesh、TTRPG 和 Shinalls 主要棋盘游戏项目的更多细节将在未来几个月内公布，这些游戏计划在零售市场发布。

news.title: 《我的世界》创作者 Notch 正在以 7000 万美元的“低价”出售他的洛杉矶豪宅
news.summary: Markus “Notch” Persson sold Minecraft developer Mojang to Microsoft back in 2014 for a cool $2.5 billion, then

others.title: 《我的世界》创作者正在出售他价值 7000 万美元的比佛利山庄豪宅，但它有一些不寻常的地方

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/06/16/minecraftchaoscubedtrailer-ign-blogroll-1781624254874.jpg

Markus “Notch” Persson sold Minecraft developer Mojang to Microsoft back in 2014 for a cool $2.5 billion, then moved to the U.S. and casually outbid Jay-Z and Beyonce for a Beverly Hills mansion . At the time, it cost him $70 million. Now, he's selling up.

Despite L.A.’s median home value more than doubling, Notch is looking for a quick sale on the mansion, a 22,300-square-foot estate which features 15 bathrooms, a $200,000 candy room, and its own private nightclub.
According to the L.A. Times , the market for housing for the super rich has cooled in the past decade, hence the “low” asking price.

If it sells, it’ll be the most expensive home sale in Beverly Hills this year and the second-priciest in L.A. County. When Notch bought it, the house boasted a 2,500-bottle wine cellar, and an art installation with a chrome machine gun as the centrepiece, as well as eight bedrooms, 15 bathrooms, a movie theatre and a swimming pool.

Notch added the nightclub, as well as a recording studio and a DJ booth to host parties for the rich and famous of Beverly Hills. According to Notch, he doesn’t spend much time in L.A. anymore, hence the sale.

Interestingly, he’s not alone. The listing coincided with a broader L.A. exit by tech moguls. Mark Zuckerberg and Google co-founders Larry Page and Sergey Brin have set up homes in Florida to avoid Proposition 40, a proposed wealth tax being voted on next week which would, if passed, levy a one-time 5% tax on the net worth of all of California's billionaires.

Apparently, it’s a cause that’s united the rich. According to Politico , a record $612 million from more than 70 current and former California billionaires was pumped into this year’s state elections, with almost 50% of the funds aimed at defeating Proposition 40. Notch didn’t mention the tax as a reason for listing the property.

The Minecraft creator hasn’t put out any major video games since he sold Minecraft to Microsoft. The game is still one of the most popular in the world and continues to get regular updates. Microsoft recently launched Minecraft Dungeons 2 , a sequel spinoff that turns the blocky Minecraft characters into warriors and mages in a Diablo-esque dungeon crawler. A Minecraft Movie, the big screen adaptation of the game, blew past $700 million at the box office. A sequel is in the works.

news.title: 10.2.2a 后端错误修复补丁
news.summary: Last week, we introduced the Backend Tunables system as a way to get small balance changes in your hands quick

content.v: Last week, we introduced the Backend Tunables system as a way to get small balance changes in your hands quicker without having to wait for patch releases. We mentioned having changes planned for a number of Killers and today, we're putting this system to use with some adjustment to The Executioner and The Good Guy.
The Executioner :
Decreased the time to activate Rites of Judgment to 0.8s (was 1s)
Increased the time to cancel Rites of Judgment to 1.2s (was 1s)
Decreased the maximum charges for Rites of Judgment to 8 (was 10)
Increased the Rites of Judgment recharge rate to 0.5 charges/s (was 0.25 c/s)
Decreased Punishment of the Damned's initial spawn delay to 0.25s (was 0.267s)
Decreased the delay between each segment of Punishment of the Damned to 0.001s (was 0.033s)
Increased each segment's lifetime to 0.3s (was 0.18s)
Increased Punishment of the Damned's maximum range to 16m (was 10m)
Dev note: Overall, our goal is to make The Executioner feel snappier when using his power, while also giving him more range to help promote those awesome plays.
The Good Guy :
Decreased Hidey-Ho mode's cooldown to 10s (was 12s)
Decreased the time to vault during Slice & Dice to 0.8s (was 1s)
Increased the maximum Slice & Dice time to 2s (was 1.8s)
Dev note: We felt that The Good Guy could use a little bit of a boost to his lethality while in power, so we've made some adjustments to put him in a better place for the long term.
As a reminder, this update does not require a download of any new content, however players will need to restart their game for the changes to take effect.

content.v: 今晚，小鹏MONA L05正式上市，定位年轻人的智能时尚大五座SUV，提供纯电和超级增程双动力共6款车型，官方售价14.48-17.68万元，限时权益价13.98-17.18万元。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/29/small_202610292252015175.jpg
何小鹏在发布会上提到，这台车追求的不是单点配置的堆料，而是一套完整的越级体验，把以往三十万级别车型才具备的产品实力，下放到十几万的价位段，围绕精致感、智能化与大空间，贴合当代年轻人的用车诉求。
整车由前法拉利设计师携手新生代造型团队共同打磨，延续家族Vital Flow设计语言，无边框车门、主动进气格栅、隐藏式水切这些潮流设计均有配备。
新车提供新月银、罗兰紫、微月灰、星云白、晶耀黑、仙踪绿六款车色。新车还带来ROAM主题套装，有专属的外观与内饰配色，专属外观与内饰定制细节。
车身尺寸方面，长宽高分别为4870/1930/1636mm，轴距2940mm，车辆配备无边框车门、隐藏式水切车窗下边沿，提供18英寸低风阻轮圈和20英寸五辐运动轮圈，20英寸轮圈搭载黄色制动卡钳罩。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/29/small_202610292252115780.jpg
座舱内部把影音和舒适体验拉满，双17.3英寸大屏分别安置于中控与后排，再搭配26.8英寸W‑HUD抬头显示，整套20扬声器音响带来沉浸式听觉享受。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/29/small_202610292252114015.jpg
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/29/small_202610292252113821.jpg
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/29/small_202610292252129684.jpg
储物能力同样可圈可点，前备厢可以收纳20英寸登机箱，常规后备厢容积702L，后排座椅放倒之后，拓展容积能够来到1913L，车内散落布置了四十多处储物格与二十余个拓展接口。
座椅配置也诚意十足，主驾驶位搭载高阶AI座椅，具备主动追腰等多项调节；副驾配置零重力座椅，支持多点位按摩。
后排靠背也支持电动角度调节，全车通风、加热、按摩功能一应俱全，前后排乘客都能享受到舒适的乘坐感受。
智能驾驶上，MONA L05搭载第二代VLA智驾体系，采用纯视觉技术路线。版本之间算力有所区分，Max系列搭载单颗图灵AI芯片，Ultra SE版本升级为双芯片，算力直接翻倍，城市NOA、高速NOA功能全部覆盖。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/29/small_202610292252296395.png
车机端的语音助手进化为Master Agent超级智能体，面对模糊的指令、复杂的多段行程，都可以依靠自然语言完成规划与交互，交互逻辑更加贴近真人对话。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/29/small_202610292252303209.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/29/small_202610292252318257.png

小鹏MONA L05在安全层面同样不含糊，新车搭载驾驶员失能辅助系统，能够自主靠边停车并触发报警救援；同时支持最高180km/h车速下爆胎平稳降速，以及AES紧急转向避让功能，把不少高端车型才有的安全能力下放至这台车上。

news.title: 游戏里氪金5.6万元仍被击败 玩家要求退款 法院判了
news.summary: 上海浦东新区法院近日处理了一起颇具话题性的游戏纠纷：一名玩家前后充值5.6万元购买游戏装备，结果对战时仍经常打不过别人，于是起…

content.v: 据快科技消息，上海浦东新区法院近日处理了一起颇具话题性的游戏纠纷：一名玩家前后充值5.6万元购买游戏装备，结果对战时仍经常打不过别人，于是起诉游戏公司，要求全额退款，最终诉讼请求被法院全部驳回。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/29/small_202610292248034087.jpg
事情发生在2024年11月至2025年10月期间。该玩家累计登录游戏1700多次，分240多笔充值，总共花掉5.6万余元，钱基本都用于购买装备，想提升角色战斗力。但即便投入这么多，实际对战中他依旧频繁被其他玩家击败。
玩家认为游戏宣传存在误导，花钱买装备没有达到预想效果，游戏公司构成违约，于是先向平台申请全额退款。遭拒后，他直接提起诉讼。游戏公司则表示，所有充值均为玩家本人自主操作，装备属性、战力数值均提前明确公示，不存在隐瞒或诱导消费，道具也已全部发放到账号，公司已履行自身义务。
法院审理后认为，双方的网络服务合同合法有效。该玩家是成年人，没有证据证明充值过程中存在被欺骗或心智不全等情况，每一笔消费均属其自主选择。
法院特别指出，网络游戏本身是竞技对抗模式，输赢取决于对手实力、个人操作、网络状态等多重因素。购买装备只能提升部分属性，并不等于保证每局必胜。仅因自己玩得不顺心、未达到心理预期就要求退款，缺乏法律依据，也不符合诚信原则，因此驳回全部诉讼请求。判决后双方均未上诉，该判决已正式生效。

news.title: 《幻影之刃零式》已经证明其发布前的炒作并非侥幸
news.summary: Just a few hours into launch, Phantom Blade Zero is already a hit game on PC. There was considerable hype behi

content.v: Just a few hours into launch, Phantom Blade Zero is already a hit game on PC. There was considerable hype behind the game as it was estimated that it had sold 1 million units before launch, and at the time of writing, it has peaked on Steam with 723,876 concurrent players. That's an impressive start for the game, and considering that it's also available on PS5, it's likely that quite a few people are enjoying its mix of soulslike-adjacent action , fight scenes choreographed by movie legend Donnie Yen, and a setting inspired by Chinese folklore.

Alinea Analytics' Rhys Elliott gave a breakdown of those preorder sales--when they had reached 850,000 units sold--explaining that 62.5% of Phantom Blade Zero's pre-launch sales came from China, Taiwan, and Hong Kong. "These markets--but predominantly China--account for 75.9% of the copies on Steam and about 24.9% on PS5," Elliott wrote, noting that the early sales had generated $43 million in revenue.

In a launch-day letter , creative director Soulframe Liang thanked the fans for Phantom Blade Zero's strong start, and the people in his studio, S-Game, for bringing his vision to life. "This is a game of immense scale, made with all the passion in our hearts. It is a gift from a small group of gamers who just happen to be developers, to every gamer who shares our love for gaming," Liang wrote.

Phantom Blade Zero is off to a strong start, but it doesn't quite look like it'll be a repeat of another hit game from the Chinese game development scene, Black Myth: Wukong. That game managed to sell an astonishing 10 million units in just its first three days, and while Phantom Blade Zero probably won't reach that same figure, it's still in the top 40 games of 2026 by revenue, according to Elliott--not too shabby considering just how packed 2026 has been with new releases.

If you're looking to get started, you can check out our Phantom Blade Zero guides hub for many walkthroughs on increasing your power and finding rare items. "S-Game's Wuxia-inspired combat puts you in the middle of a Chinese action movie," Richard Wakeling wrote in GameSpot's Phantom Blade Zero review .

news.title: 为了证明清白，警察逼着他打了局游戏
news.summary: Fbi open the door！

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2022/10/21/small_202210211829418927.png
假如你是名寄居国外的职业选手，寻常的一天里，却忽然被“FBI open the door”。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261029_hhy_641_1/14412.jpg
警察二话不说就给你上了手铐，拿走护照、切掉你的网络，关掉你的电脑，然后让你自证身份。
你向他介绍自己是电子游戏职业选手，可对面的警察从没听说过你，也没听说过你的战队，甚至没听过你玩的游戏。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261029_hhy_641_1/14785.jpg
此时你该怎么办？
前不久这一幕就发生在马来西亚，知名DOTA2选手23savage为了自证身份，不得不当着警察的面，杀了三十几个人（游戏里）。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261029_hhy_641_1/15769.jpg
在此之前，23savage刚和队友打完训练赛，正玩着手机唱着歌，警察就毫无征兆地闯了进来。
一通手铐、关机、断网的流程下来后，就开始了经典环节：你怎么证明你是你。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261029_hhy_641_1/18787.jpg
这让23savage跟队友多少都有些懵逼，因为他们在《DOTA2》中算不上知名选手，更不知道该怎么跟连《DOTA2》不认识的警察，介绍自己。
读到这儿，或许你也会对23savage这个名字十分陌生。但如果你对《DOTA2》的赛事还有些了解，那一定听过23savage的另一个外号——“香槟神🍾”。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261029_hhy_641_1/22452.jpg
2023年7月，在2023利亚德大师赛上，23savage所在的Talon Esports对阵Liquid战队。在BO3的最后一局，23savage方已胜券在握，开始团推对面基地。
https://imggif.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/29/origin_202610291947477692.gif
自认为“优势在我”的23savage，在游戏还没结束时就甩掉耳机，开始站起身摇头晃脑庆祝。
https://imggif.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/29/origin_202610291947369030.gif
而在同一时刻，Liquid的选手也在偷偷进攻他们的基地，于是结果不出意外地出了意外：他们被对手翻盘了。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261029_hhy_641_1/31265.jpg
打完委屈屈了
也不知道是经此一役受了打击，还是他的天赋本就如此。此次“2023利亚德大师赛”既是他的高光，也成了他职业生涯的最高顶点（目前）。
https://imggif.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/29/origin_202610291947234212.gif
如果他真被打击了，可以到《街霸6》里找找另一位“香槟神”Punk讨讨心得
23savage在今年8月加入了这支Xipto Esports，目前战队仍是在二三线赛事中挣扎。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261029_hhy_641_1/33093.jpg
说好听点，这是一支潜力非凡、未来可期，充满阳光与拼劲，但目前时运不济的年轻队伍。
说难听点就是：路边一条。
你要问他们能不能赚钱，那可能得引用“二仙桥大爷”的名言：“能赚，但只能赚一点点”。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261029_hhy_641_1/33581.jpg
这让23savage的人生看起来如此诡谲传奇，似乎除了职业成绩，他什么奇葩事都能碰上。
说回到这次事件。尽管23savage跟队友一再跟警方解释，但警察基本就是不认识、没听过、我不道啊。
转头又开始盘问他们“是不是职业选手”。
所幸在经历一番拉扯后，一名自称了解过DOTA2且认识Fnatic战队的警员出现后，事态才逐渐缓和下来。
这名警员还在23savage的IG上认出了他和马来西亚女网红Puiyi的合影
至此，这场乌龙事件理应该结束了。但不知是警员还未打消疑虑，还是有其他的原因，在解开23savage的手铐后，还顺势让他开了局游戏。
从结果来看，那局游戏23savage应该算是憋了肚子火，局势焦灼下，他一个人单砍32个人头，独占队伍的一半。可以说是凭一己之力扛着队友拿下的游戏。
当然，如果战绩不好看，我们估计也看不到23savage分享这个新闻了。
在看到23savage大杀特杀后，警察这才悻悻离去。而在我看来，警察可能早就相信了他的身份，之所以死活要看他打一把，更多是要吃完自己手上的“巧克力榛子酱”。
对了，这两罐巧克力酱还是警察从23savage那里顺的。
尽管马来西亚警方在后续并未对这次破门审讯给出过官方解释，但对于许多在东南亚从事软件与游戏开发的小工作室而言，对这种事估计已经脱敏了。
毕竟早在十年前开始，东南亚警方就已经闹出过类似的乌龙事件了。
2014年的时候，法国游戏厂商Gameloft位于印度尼西亚的一处分部就曾遭到警方类似的暴力闯入。
他们的便衣警察不仅在闯入时揍了一顿拦截的门卫，甚至首次闯入时也根本没有搜查批文，很像是场没有预案的突然袭击。
同样是强行进入，同样是控制盘查，同样是一群什么都不懂的警察进门就问东问西，你们怎么赚钱？你们给玩家的奖品是什么？
警方的说辞是，接到群众的举报，怀疑这里是一个涉嫌网络博彩的据点。当他们对在场的电脑进行一系列严格的搜查后，确信这个有几百人的公司真从事游戏开发后，才选择离去。
彼时他们吃没吃到巧克力酱我不清楚，但当时警方的这次突然搜查却被部分当地媒体解读为“不专业”。
因为Gameloft开发的游戏虽然当下在国内知名度一般，但其中部分作品在印尼的口碑却还算可以。比如借由小黄人IP开发的跑酷游戏《Minion Rush》（《小黄人快跑》），全球范围有着累计数亿下载量。
因此只因一个举报，就把这么大一个开发工作室当成嫌疑据点，最起码是没怎么做功课。
（要不先在门口拉个路人问问呢？）
不过哪怕警方已经算如此不讲武德了，Gameloft对这场乌龙也没做什么表态，大抵是还能怎么办呢，当然是选择原谅它了。
而在23savage分享经历后，其评论区也出现了许多东南亚网友分享类似经历，其中大多数为从事IT或游戏开发的小型工作室。
这些公司（工作室）通常也都会有类似的特点：本国与外籍人士混住、屋内有大量的电脑设备、经常点外卖，以及经常隐藏在居民区内等等。
如果你拿这些特征对照23savage的战队基地，会发现其基本都吻合。而同样还符合这些特征的，正是警察真正的目标，那些遍布在东南亚的电诈、博彩平台的线下据点。
尽管此前东南亚多国早已将“线上博彩”列为非法产业，但由于种种原因，其国内仍然是博彩平台非法运营的温床。
因此当出现符合特征的工作室或群众举报时，警方很多时候都要搞类似的突然袭击。
这倒也不是警方风声鹤唳，而是经过严厉打击后，许多的小型非法据点都变得十分狡猾。不仅藏得位置愈发的隐蔽，许多据点还都会打着正经IT、软件开发、计算机服务的名义注册公司。
答应我，不要当赌狗好吗
招收有身份的外籍劳工，并且为员工正经缴纳社保，甚至某些公司还真会做个产品来应付检查。如果不是警方突然袭击抓现行，很多时候还真容易被他们蒙混过去。

news.title: Xbox女老大发声：主机供不应求 正努力增加供货
news.summary: Xbox首席执行官阿莎·夏尔马（Asha Sharma）近日发布了新的声明，谈及公司营收表现的改善，并称赞了近期推出的多款游戏。

content.v: Xbox首席执行官阿莎·夏尔马（Asha Sharma）近日发布了新的声明，谈及公司营收表现的改善，并称赞了近期推出的多款游戏。同时，她也表示，Xbox主机目前的市场需求依然超过供应量，微软正在努力提高供货能力，让更多玩家能够买到主机。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/29/small_202610292231012685.png
在《使命召唤：现代战争4》取得亮眼开局后，夏尔马近日在社交平台X上发文，对《现代战争4》《我的世界》以及《魔兽世界：无限》等作品表示肯定。
她还公布了Xbox的部分财务表现：“第一季度，Xbox营收同比下降2%，相比之下，上一季度的同比降幅为10%；与此同时，我们的问责利润率有所改善。”而PC平台营收实现了两位数增长。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/29/small_202610292231147686.png
除了营收和游戏表现，夏尔马也谈到了Xbox主机的生产情况，以及目前主机在市场上的供应状况。
她表示：“主机销量仍受到供应限制，市场需求超过了现有主机的供应量。我们正在努力让更多主机进入玩家手中，其中也包括扩大翻新主机计划的覆盖范围。我们已经取得了一些进展，但接下来还有很多工作要做。”
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/29/small_202610292231234404.png
需要注意的是，夏尔马并没有表示Xbox主机已经无法购买。根据原报道的调查结果，美国和英国多家大型线上零售商目前仍有Xbox主机在售。

news.title: GTA 6 的警察会派狗来抓你
news.summary: The police in GTA 6 are smarter and more capable than they were in GTA 5, and that includes the newly confirme

content.v: The police in GTA 6 are smarter and more capable than they were in GTA 5, and that includes the newly confirmed detail that cops can dispatch dogs to hunt you down.

Edge Magazine recently posted a preview of the game with Rockstar's Rob Nelson playing. In one sequence, Jason and Lucia are attempting to evade police when they crash their motorcycle and try to escape on foot. However, nearby cops send out a K9 unit to assist. One of the dogs, a German Shepherd, quickly grabs Jason and pins him to the ground. According to Edge, developers standing by during the preview urged Nelson not to shoot the dog.

This implies that it's possible to shoot police dogs, and that wouldn't be surprising, as GTA 5 lets you shoot and kill dogs as well. We previously learned that players can pet the dog in GTA 6, or they can scold it .

In real life, police in Miami--which is parodied as Vice City in GTA 6--and other places around the country do indeed use specially trained dogs for crimefighting. Miami, in fact, just welcomed a new dog, Samson , who is also a German shepherd like the one in GTA 6.

GTA 6 features a six-star Wanted system and an expanded criminal profile system that allows cops to track you down with a wider net . Additionally, the game now notifies you if you've been seen by a CCTV camera, for example, and if so, you can destroy the evidence to evade the fuzz. Cops also remember the specific clothing that Jason and Lucia are wearing, so players may need to change clothes to escape.

In other dog-related GTA 6 news, the newest episode of South Park contained brand-new GTA 6 gameplay footage showing Jason hurling dog poop at another person , and then picking up the poop again to smack them with it.
GTA 6 launches on November 19 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. After that, Rockstar could release GTA 6 Online and a PC edition in early 2027 .

news.title: 由于奇怪的错误，一些支付了《魔兽世界》永久名字保留费用的人无法保留他们的名字
news.summary: After the World of Warcraft Forever beta ended last week, Blizzard opened up the servers to character creation

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/28/worldofwarcraftforeverwarpathamvlaunchtrailer-ign-blogroll-1793224828816.jpg

After the World of Warcraft Forever beta ended last week, Blizzard opened up the servers to character creation in order to allow players who bought one of the Skyborne packs to reserve their names. But a lot of people were falsely given a "restricted" message when they tried to reserve their name.

Even after the rough start that Blizzard's name reservation system had on Tuesday , some players weren't able to reserve their name, with the character creation screen telling them their name was on the restricted list. Blizzard has since fixed the problem, and told players it was due to a bugged name filter.

Community manager Kaivax took to the WoW Forever forums to explain: "In WoW Forever, we’ve been working on the restricted name list, which is a list the game uses to check for non-profane names that we wish to restrict, such as major Warcraft lore characters or names that are blocked for technical reasons. Today we’ve determined that we have a bug in the process that caused the game to be overly restrictive with some names. For example, it has been incorrectly restricting names containing 'c-o-n.'"

In the replies to Kaivax's post, it was made clear that the name filter was a bit overzealous. Player Nursejoy posted: "Major Warcraft lore characters? I understand that but it seems any named NPC is on the list. Example: Generically named NPCs 'Nurse' and 'Officer' hardly hold major Warcraft lore but names containing 'nurse' are restricted. This is a specifically bad example to illustrate impact." They then went on to list 23 different character names with the word 'nurse' that they supposedly tried to reserve, but couldn't.

According to Kaivax, the fixes should have gone live with the server restart, but some players are still reporting problems reserving their names. However, I've been able to go in and reserve the name 'Concon Concon,' so the specific combination that Kaivax mentioned does seem to have been fixed at least.

But while this overly strict name filter appears to have been a bug, WoW Forever has been fairly strict on character names. There was a controversy relatively early in the beta about names being reported, and Blizzard had to come out and reassure players that humans were reviewing the reports . I also got a chance to sit down with WoW Forever principal game designer Kris Zierhut to talk about the future of the game , and it seems like the team is laser-focused on making it an even more social version of the MMO.

news.title: FromSoftware 的 Nintendo Switch 2 独家游戏《黄昏之血》正式推迟到 2027 年
news.summary: FromSoftware has announced a delay of The Duskbloods to 2027. The Nintendo Switch 2 exclusive was due out by t

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/29/theduskbloods-02-1793283021116.jpg
FromSoftware has announced a delay of The Duskbloods to 2027. The Nintendo Switch 2 exclusive was due out by the end of 2026.

In a statement published online, the Dark Souls and Elden Ring developer said that it had decided to delay the game following feedback from the recent network test, with a focus on combat, strategic depth, and player expression.
There’s no word on when in 2027 The Duskbloods will launch.

Fans had braced themselves for a delay after The Duskblood was among a number of no-shows at the September 2026 Nintendo Direct . Before that, in August, FromSoftware brought The Duskbloods network test to an early end after the first day of testing resulted in "game server issues" that barred players from logging in.

FromSoftware is responsible for some of the most influential games of the last 20 years, including 2022 masterpiece Elden Ring. So anticipation for The Duskbloods to recreate some of that FromSoftware magic on Switch 2 is sky high.
Until there is more to share, you can read IGN's interview with FromSoftware's Hidetaka Miyazaki . You can also check out our preview .
Here's FromSoftware's statement in full:

While development of "The Duskbloods" is at the final adjustment stage, we have made the decision to move the launch window to 2027. We apologize to players who have been kindly awaiting the release of this title and thank you for your patience and support.

During the network test, we saw active interest in the core concepts of the game, including combat, strategic depth, and player expression. To further enhance these aspects, we have decided to move the launch, allowing time for final adjustments to game rules and balancing.

content.v: From Software has announced that its upcoming Switch 2 game The Duskbloods will not make it out on time this year--it's now scheduled for release in 2027. That's as specific as the studio got, however, so there is no telling when next year the game could be released.
"We apologize to players who have been kindly awaiting the release of this title and thank you for your patience and support," the studio said.

From Software added that the delay will allow the studio to "further enhance" the game's core concepts, including combat, strategic depth, and player expression. "We have decided to move the launch, allowing time for final adjustments to game rules and balancing," the team explained.
The Duskbloods was a no-show at the September Nintendo Direct, prompting some fans to worry about its development state .

In getting delayed to 2027, The Duskbloods will stay out of the blast zone of GTA 6, if that's something From Software and Nintendo are even concerned about. Whatever the case, excitement is high for The Duskbloods. A From Software employee recently revealed that interest in The Duskbloods' playtest surpassed that of Elden Ring Nightreign’s .
The Duskbloods is a multiplayer PvPvE game that's directed by From Software's Hidetaka Miyazaki.
GameSpot’s Jake Dekker came away impressed during his hands-on The Duskbloods preview , saying he’d “never played anything like it” and “couldn’t wait to play more.”

news.title: 《影之刃零》画质太糊了？可能是这个设置没调对

content.v: 《影之刃零》正式发售后，部分玩家在体验过程中反馈游戏画面表现不及预期。游民商城9折热卖中，少量含预购库存售完为止！
《影之刃零》 热销进行中 ！叠加金币至高省32元，目前购买依然可得预购奖励，预购版数量有限！
对此，有玩家及技术博主指出，画质不佳可能是因为游戏内某项默认设置未处于最佳状态，建议玩家手动检查并调整“超分辨率输出分辨率”选项。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/29/small_202610291530053755.jpg
据玩家分享的信息显示，《影之刃零》的“超分辨率输出分辨率”（Super Resolution Output Scale）在默认状态下设定为“自动（AUTO）”，且实际渲染比例默认为75%。这意味着游戏默认并未以100%的原生比例进行超分输出，这在一定程度上牺牲了画面的清晰度与细节。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/29/small_202610291529197726.png
对此，建议玩家进入游戏的画面设置菜单，不要完全依赖默认的AUTO选项。玩家应根据自身硬件配置，在画质清晰度与帧数流畅度之间进行手动权衡调整：如果硬件性能允许，可以尝试将输出分辨率拉高至100%，以获得更锐利、更纯粹的画面；如果帧数吃紧，则适当调低比例以保证游玩体验。
目前，《影之刃零》已在PS5和PC平台全面发售。对于追求极致画面的玩家来说，深入菜单对各项参数进行微调，无疑是提升游戏沉浸感的重要途径。

news.title: 《影之刃零》开荒轮椅!外媒力荐最强武器 投资不亏
news.summary: 近日，外媒PC Gamer发文探讨了动作RPG中经典的“出血”机制，并重点推荐了《影之刃零》中一把极为强力的前期出血武器——“残钢刃”…

content.v: 近日，外媒PC Gamer发文探讨了动作RPG中经典的“出血”机制，并重点推荐了《影之刃零》中一把极为强力的前期出血武器——“残钢刃”（Jagged Steel）。文章指出，在游戏前期入手这把武器，将极大降低推图与Boss战的难度。游民商城9折热卖中，少量含预购库存售完为止！
《影之刃零》 热销进行中 ！叠加金币至高省32元，目前购买依然可得预购奖励，预购版数量有限！
在《影之刃零》中，出血（Bleed）不仅会造成持续伤害，还会在敌人身上积攒状态条，一旦打满便会爆发出巨额伤害。而玩家在面对游戏中的第一个Boss“残钢”时，就能亲身体验到被出血支配的恐惧。击败该Boss后，玩家便可获得这把同名武器。
这把剑的核心机制是“流血”（Blood Blade），这是一个可叠加的Buff，能够同时提升出血的累积速度和造成的伤害。随着武器等级的提升，其威力会呈指数级增长：
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/29/small_202610291649442080.jpg
5级：对处于破防状态的敌人发动特殊攻击时，可直接获得一层“流血”。
10级：进一步提升出血累积速度。
15级：允许玩家蓄力斩击，在释放前叠加多层“流血”。
20级：再次大幅增加出血累积。
此外，该武器的左扳机强化连招能释放一阵狂风骤雨般的斩击，极速施加出血效果，几乎能保证每次连招都必定触发敌人的出血状态。由于《影之刃零》中绝大多数Boss都是人型敌人，这使得“残钢刃”在前期极其强势。
当然，“残钢刃”也有盲区。游戏中的部分敌人免疫出血。但PC Gamer指出，只要在找到Livingwood Talisman护符，就能让出血效果对这些免疫情敌人生效（效果为50%）。若进一步打磨该饰品，效果可提升至70%。
这意味着，这把武器将能对游戏中的所有敌人和Boss发挥出近乎全额的出血威力。PC Gamer的编辑表示，自己游玩了大约30个小时，虽然尝试了各种其他武器，甚至在副手配备了双刀，但主手依然死死焊在“残钢刃”上，因为它的输出能力实在太过强大。
最后，文章向玩家给出建议：如果你想在《影之刃零》的前期让游戏轻松一些，投资升级“残钢刃”绝对不会让你后悔。

news.title: GTA 6 以自己的方式让熟悉的开放世界游戏功能发挥作用
news.summary: One feature Grand Theft Auto 6 borrows from modern-day open-world games is the ability to call a ride whenever

content.v: One feature Grand Theft Auto 6 borrows from modern-day open-world games is the ability to call a ride whenever you need it, but in true Rockstar fashion, it comes with a bit of real-life friction. It's not quite as simple as hitting a button to " even the odds " when you need to make a fast getaway.

As GamesRadar's GTA 6 cover story details, you'll have the option to summon your car via a smartphone app. It won't magically appear, as the Scooter Bros. app will see a company employee drop your vehicle off at your location--for a small fee, of course. Just like the car drop-off services you'll find in real life, these couriers have a compact scooter stashed in the trunk of your car, and they'll ride off into the sunset once they've done their job.

Just don't expect to have time to make a call if you're in the middle of a robbery; you'll need to plan ahead and make sure you have a getaway vehicle nearby. While you can steal a car off a street, it brings a new set of complications. You might run into a driver ready to fight back, the car might have a tracker inside, and it might also be low on fuel.

If you're worried you'll have to refuel often, Rockstar Games described this facet of GTA 6 as a quick diversion, and cars can run for a long time before you need to top up the fuel tank with a fresh supply of go-go juice.

But if you're planning to embark on a life of crime in the game, it looks like there will be several things to account for as Rockstar aims to make GTA 6 an immersive entry in the series with multiple systems in play.

Ahead of its release on November 19 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, the marketing for GTA 6 has kicked up a gear as more details on the game come to light. We've also learned that the GTA 6 landmass is nearly as big as the playable maps in GTA 4, GTA 5, and Red Dead Redemption 2 combined, the download size is appropriately huge , and a new episode of South Park showed off a new system for being crappy toward your fellow NPCs.

news.title: GTA 6：原创乐谱已确定发行日期，并且您可以立即收听全新曲目
news.summary: The Grand Theft Auto VI: Original Score launches on December 11 across all major music streaming services, Roc

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/29/unnamed-7-1793280697268.png
The Grand Theft Auto VI: Original Score launches on December 11 across all major music streaming services, Rockstar Games has announced. It’s also due out then on double CD and triple vinyl.

The GTA 6: Original Score is by Grammy Award-winning French electronic duo Justice, and features 30 tracks from the band’s full suite of material composed for the game. This includes Flower in a Hurricane ft. Tame Impala, SZA, and King Gizzard & The Lizard Wizard, and a number of digital bonus tracks included across all formats.
Today, Justice released a new track called Pusher , which features fellow French electronic music artist Gesaffelstein.
Here's the official blurb:

The Grand Theft Auto VI: Original Score 2xCD and 3xLP – available in a limited crystal clear edition as well as standard black – features 30 tracks and a number of bonus digital tracks comprising a 3 hour-long suite of material from the game.

Hand-selected for the assignment, Justice (Gaspard Augé and Xavier de Rosnay) worked in close collaboration with the team at Rockstar Games to match the thematic beats of the gameplay experience, fine tuning their signature sound to align with the immersive world of Grand Theft Auto VI and the story of Jason and Lucia. As a result, the band’s score is dynamically tuned to game events as they unfold, constantly reacting in response to the different ways players engage with the people and places across Leonida.

“The scope of the game is so large geographically and thematically that it was clear from the beginning the music would also have to be very broad in terms of emotions, genres, and textures” states de Rosnay. “We were given the freedom to explore as many things as we needed to, musically speaking.”

The duo previewed the score via their massive hit “Flower In a Hurricane (ft. Tame Impala, SZA, and King Gizzard & The Lizard Wizard),” which marked Justice’s first non-feature song to hit the Billboard Hot 100 at #62 and debuted at #34 on the US Alternative Radio chart. Today they share another taste of the album with “Pusher,” a preview of the instrumental side of the score featuring their first-ever collaboration with fellow French electronic music pioneer Gesaffelstein.

Rockstar had already released previews of select in-game radio stations, along with featured singles from Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album, on the Music section of the official GTA 6 website, giving fans a taste of what’s to come.

Speaking of GTA 6’s music, British singer Cliff Richard has enjoyed a surprise resurgence at the age of 86 after one of his old songs featured in the GTA 6 Extended Look on Netflix . Devil Woman, a 1976 single from his album I'm Nearly Famous, saw a bump in popularity after featuring on 2017 movie I, Tonya, but it exploded after appearing in the GTA 6 gameplay, with a 325% increase in daily streams. However, Richard himself doesn’t really understand what’s happening here, and, in a recent interview, didn’t seem to know what GTA was .

We’ve got plenty more on GTA 6 while you wait for its November 19 release date, including an unlikely gameplay reveal in the latest episode of South Park , how GTA 6 named one of its biggest mechanics after a beloved GTA 4 meme , and how GTA 6's map will open up relatively early and let you explore freely .

news.title: 《影之刃零》PC优化指南来了！画质不降帧数上涨39%
news.summary: 日前，外媒Wccftech发布《影之刃零》PC性能分析与优化指南。

content.v: 日前，外媒Wccftech发布《影之刃零》PC性能分析与优化指南。
《影之刃零》 热销进行中 ！叠加金币至高省32元，目前购买依然可得预购奖励，预购版数量有限！
文中指出，《影之刃零》的整体画面表现相当出色，尤其是在角色建模、氛围营造和光照效果方面。《影之刃零》虽在正式进入游戏前设置了较长时间的着色器编译流程，但成功消除了绝大多数由着色器编译引起的卡顿。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/29/small_202610292125105680.png
Wccftech使用以下电脑配置进行测试：
CPU： 英特尔 Core i7-14700K
显卡： NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090 24GB
内存： 32GB DDR5-7000
显卡驱动： NVIDIA GeForce Game Ready 621.01
各项画面设置的对比测试均在2560×1440分辨率下进行，并使用虚幻引擎5的时域超分辨率技术（TSR），将渲染分辨率设置为原生分辨率。
测试结果如下：
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/29/small_202610292125307474.png
在关闭光线追踪的情况下，Core i7-14700K取得了202.1 FPS的平均帧率，1%低帧率为133.8 FPS，0.1%低帧率为96.4 FPS。虽然偶尔会出现帧时间波动，但测试过程中，帧时间通常能够维持在4至6毫秒左右。
开启光线追踪后，平均帧率下降至134.4 FPS，降幅达到33.5%。相比之下，1%低帧率下降幅度较小，为23.6%；0.1%低帧率则变化不大，从96.4 FPS降至95.3 FPS。
开启路径追踪后，平均帧率进一步下降至125.6 FPS，相比传统光栅化渲染降低了37.9%。1%低帧率下降27.5%，0.1%低帧率则下降约10.8%。
这些结果表明，光线追踪和路径追踪会显著增加CPU端的工作负载。不过，即使启用这些高级渲染功能，现代高端处理器依然能够提供相当不错的性能。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/29/small_202610292125591479.png
在对各项画面设置进行对比后，Wccftech发现，以下选项值得优先调整：
阴影质量
光照质量
特效质量
材质质量
视距
环境细节质量
高质量头发
另一方面，反射质量、环境光遮蔽质量、角色纹理质量、角色模型质量和环境模型质量建议继续保持“极致”设置，因为降低这些选项带来的性能收益十分有限，反而可能造成不必要的画面损失。
媒体建议优化设置如下：
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/29/small_202610292126296752.png
媒体表示在这套优化方案下，游戏平均帧率从74 FPS提升至103FPS，增幅达到39%。
低帧表现同样有明显改善：1%低帧率从63 FPS提升至87 FPS，0.1%低帧率则从62 FPS提升至83 FPS，分别提高38%和34%。
在正常游戏过程中，大部分画质差异并不明显，而操作响应速度和整体帧率的改善则能够直接感受到。
玩家还可以在这套设置的基础上启用时域超分辨率技术，进一步提高帧率。如果使用高刷新率显示器，也可以考虑开启帧生成技术，但前提是基础帧率足够高，从而确保操作响应及时，并尽量减少画面伪影。
Wccftech认为，《影之刃零》是一款画面表现出色的虚幻引擎5游戏。无论是精细的角色渲染、富有氛围感的环境，还是开启光线追踪和路径追踪后的光照效果，都展现出了不错的水准。Wccftech的优化方案在保留大部分“极致”画质表现的同时，让平均帧率提升39%，1%低帧率提升38%，0.1%低帧率提升34%。
以上测试结果及画质优化建议仅供参考，实际游戏表现可能因硬件配置、驱动版本及系统环境等因素而有所不同，玩家可根据自身设备情况进行调整。

content.v: 快科技10月29日消息，今日，王腾创办的今日宜休正式发布首款硬件产品——ISHO Ring智能戒指，带来ISHO Ring和ISHO Ring Pro两款产品，售价分别为1799元和2199元。
据了解，两款智能戒指的核心健康功能保持一致，均支持睡眠分期、睡眠指标监测、精力管理、日晒监测、健康提示以及运动识别等功能。
两款产品的主要区别在于充电仓，其中，ISHO Ring Pro配备的专属充电仓额外支持随身环境监测功能。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/29/small_202610292124057526.png
该充电仓可检测空气中的二氧化碳浓度、温湿度、噪音和光照等环境数据，并将监测结果与用户睡眠数据关联分析，帮助用户了解可能影响睡眠质量的环境因素。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/29/small_202610292124149440.png
官方表示，如果主要关注基础健康监测，可以选择ISHO Ring；如果希望获得更完整的睡眠监测与分析体验，则可以选择ISHO Ring Pro。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/29/small_202610292124222845.png
ISHO Ring首发曙光金、星空银、谧夜黑三款配色，戒指内外圈均采用TC4钛合金材质，搭配一体化机身设计。
硬件配置上，ISHO Ring搭载Apollo 330B Plus芯片，内置OSRAM光电二极管（PPG）、ADI模拟前端、ADI皮肤温度传感器以及六轴IMU惯性测量单元。
同时，戒指还配备32MB存储空间，可独立保存最多7天的健康数据。
续航方面，ISHO Ring采用叠片卷绕结构弧形电池，续航时间为6至10天，支持无线充电，Pro版还配备专属充电仓。
此外，戒指支持10ATM级防水，可在游泳等场景下佩戴使用。
值得一提的是，官方特别强调，ISHO Ring并非医疗设备，直接"治病"。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/29/small_202610292124295893.png
其主要作用是结合心率、血氧等身体指标以及环境监测数据，帮助用户分析睡眠质量不佳的可能原因，并提供相应的改善建议。

news.title: 《巫师3重制版》突然更新！CDPR火速解决游戏问题
news.summary: CDPR今日发文宣布，《巫师3：狂猎—重制版》的热修复补丁现已在PC平台正式推出，集中修复了游戏内两个影响玩家体验的问题。

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/29/small_202610292112083151.jpg
CDPR今日发文宣布，《巫师3：狂猎—重制版》的热修复补丁现已在PC平台正式推出，集中修复了游戏内两个影响玩家体验的问题。
根据官方公布的更新说明，本次热修复补丁主要包含两项内容：
首先，修复了在禁用部分模组后，游戏内物品和装备会异常消失的问题，保障了玩家存档与道具的完整；
其次，修复了在“新游戏+”模式中，火焰马眼罩无法正常显示的Bug，恢复了该装备的视觉外观。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/29/small_202610292111456319.png
作为经典大作的次世代重制版，CDPR此次迅速响应并推出热修复，及时解决了部分PC玩家遇到的痛点，进一步优化了游玩体验。

news.title: IGN大赞《影之刃零》绝妙设计！业内都应该学一学
news.summary: 外媒IGN近日发布了一篇由Travis Northup撰写的观点文章，重点探讨了当前硬核动作游戏中的惩罚机制。文章高度赞扬了《影之刃零》的设…

content.v: 外媒IGN近日发布了一篇由Travis Northup撰写的观点文章，重点探讨了当前硬核动作游戏中的惩罚机制。文章高度赞扬了《影之刃零》的设计，认为其在Boss战中的阶段检查点机制，为行业提供了一个摆脱“无谓时间浪费”的优秀范本。游民商城9折热卖中，少量含预购库存售完为止！
《影之刃零》 热销进行中 ！叠加金币至高省32元，目前购买依然可得预购奖励，预购版数量有限！
作者在文中提出了一个名为“Scrub Tax”（菜鸟税/手残税）的概念，用来形容玩家在游戏失败后被迫经历的烦人流程，比如长达一分钟的跑图、每次都要重看的不可跳过过场动画，或是漫长的加载时间。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/29/small_202610292108083572.jpg
作者指出，在众多魂类或高难度动作游戏中，如果在Boss战中死亡，玩家必须从头开始重打。这导致玩家将大量时间浪费在已经掌握的前期阶段，真正面对挑战的时间反而很少。例如在《匹诺曹的谎言》中，作者曾因反复重打缓慢的Boss第一阶段而彻底丧失了获胜的喜悦。
对此，IGN作者表示，《影之刃零》打破了这种行业惯例。游戏开发团队S-GAME在Boss战中加入了阶段检查点。玩家如果在后续阶段死亡，可以直接在对应阶段重新开始。这使得每次死亡的成本降到了30秒以内，玩家能够迅速重新投入战斗，保持了极佳的游戏节奏。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/29/small_202610292108157565.jpg
作者进一步分析，这种设计不仅没有削弱游戏的难度，反而解放了开发者的创造力。因为不用担心死亡会浪费玩家太多时间，开发者可以放开手脚，设计出更具创意、攻击性更强甚至一击必杀的Boss招式。
作者认为，强迫玩家从头重打Boss是一种廉价增加难度的手段，业界应当重新思考这种设计。与其让玩家在无意义的重复中消耗耐心，不如提供类似跳过已熟练阶段或更快重开的机制，让玩家在纯粹的挑战中获得乐趣。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/29/small_202610292108225220.jpg

news.title: R星官宣GTA6新情报！顶级设计改变玩家游戏体验
news.summary: Rockstar Games今日正式公布了《GTA 6》原声带（Original Score）的详细信息。

content.v: Rockstar Games今日正式公布了《GTA 6》原声带（Original Score）的详细信息。
该原声带由曾获格莱美奖的法国知名电子音乐双人组Justice（Gaspard Augé与Xavier de Rosnay）操刀制作。
官方介绍称，Justice为游戏带来了极具标志性的音色。 这套原声带采用了动态自适应设计，其宏大的曲目将根据玩家在罪恶都市与莱昂尼达州的探索方式，以及Jason与Lucia的故事走向进行动态调整，以契合玩家的游戏体验。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/29/small_202610292103129732.jpg
该原声带专辑将于12月11日登陆各大主流音乐流媒体平台，并同步推出CD和黑胶唱片实体版。
专辑共收录30首曲目，其中包括由Tame Impala、SZA和King Gizzard & The Lizard Wizard参与合作的《Flower in a Hurricane》（该曲目已在发售预告片中使用），以及与Gesaffelstein合作并于今日首发的新单曲《Pusher》。全专辑在所有版本中还将包含多首数字附赠曲目。
目前，玩家已可以预存完整专辑或预购实体版本，官方还提供了一款特别限量的透明水晶三黑胶（Triple Crystal Clear vinyl）供玩家收藏。
此外，玩家可以访问《GTA 6》官网的音乐板块，提前试听游戏内部分电台的曲目以及《GTA 6: The Album》的重点单曲。

content.v: 《影之刃零》今日正式发售后，其在PC平台的市场表现迎来了全面爆发。游民商城9折热卖中，少量含预购库存售完为止！
《影之刃零》 热销进行中 ！叠加金币至高省32元，目前购买依然可得预购奖励，预购版数量有限！
根据游民星空最新数据，本作不仅稳居Steam全球销量榜首，更在多个国家和地区实现了销量霸榜。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/29/small_202610292043021649.jpg
